checkpoints.description: [1/3] Plan docked trade automation: persist a buy-low/sell-high broker policy, execute on a safe cooldown, and wire API/CLI/cockpit with regressions.

impact_assessment.why: Trading requires repeated manual clicks; there is no way to leave a standing price policy running while handling navigation, combat or diplomacy.
impact_assessment.benefits: A docked captain can automate a local market strategy, realized results are visible, and trade progression continues between other actions.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: new state field must default for legacy saves and the broker must not trade in transit/combat/decision/void; dependency: reuses the normal trade path; concurrency: tick-time trade mutates state, stats, cargo and credits, so the automation record updates after the trade clone; state: cooldown and realized totals must persist.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Add engine, persistence, API, CLI and layout tests first; clamp quantity and thresholds; route through normal trade; verify a live Edge enable and multiple automated buys.

checkpoints.description: [2/3] TradeAutomation model, docked broker with 3-tick cooldown, safe-action guards, realized-credit tracking, /api/trade/automation and autotrade CLI implemented with regressions.
[3/3] Commerce broker panel, README/COCKPIT and ADR-093 recorded; live Edge enabled a fuel-cell buy and executed three trades by tick 15. 826 tests and 5/5 gates pass. checklists: passed
Task 'trade-automation' completed successfully.
[1/3] Plan visible faction diplomacy: reject duplicate alliances, expose improve/gift/ally/ceasefire in the Empire tab, and make allied territory cut pirate risk.

impact_assessment.why: Faction alliance existed in the engine but the cockpit only exposed IMPROVE, a second alliance silently succeeded, and allied space gave no patrol benefit, so diplomacy was neither visible nor meaningful.
impact_assessment.benefits: Players can see and use every diplomatic action, alliances are a one-time milestone, and allied patrols make friendly territory measurably safer.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: alliance must stay gated at standing 70 and the new allied flag must not apply to Unclaimed space; dependency: pirate_risk signature gains a default-False parameter; concurrency: diplomacy mutates standings, credits, allies and the flight log in one locked transaction; state: allies must persist and duplicate formation must be refused.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Add engine, pirate-risk and cockpit layout regressions first; default the new pirate_risk flag; gate allied reduction on a real faction; verify alliance formation in live Edge.

checkpoints.description: [2/3] Duplicate alliance refusal, ALLIANCE FORMED flight log, allied pirate-risk modifier gated to claimed space, and Empire-tab IMPROVE/GIFT/ALLY/PETITION actions with ALLIED/WAR labels implemented with regressions.
[3/3] README, COCKPIT and ADR-094 recorded; live Edge formed a Sol Coalition alliance; 829 tests and 5/5 gates pass. checklists: passed
Task 'faction-alliances' completed successfully.
[1/3] Plan legible fleet veterancy: rank thresholds and combat bonuses, scaled battle XP, docked training, fleet-card rank/XP/TRAIN UI, API, CLI and regressions.

impact_assessment.why: Escort experience existed but was invisible, its damage bonus was an opaque 1% per point, and there was no way to invest credits in a favourite hull.
impact_assessment.benefits: Veteran escorts become a visible progression goal, promotions are announced, and drydock training gives the mid-game economy a meaningful credit sink.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: existing saves and fleet reports must keep working and XP must cap at 300; dependency: fleet damage and evasion formulas change for every battle; concurrency: training mutates credits, fleet roster and flight log in one locked transaction; state: experience is already persisted, but training must refuse at the cap and for destroyed hulls.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Add rank, damage, evasion, training and API/CLI/UI tests first; clamp XP everywhere; default the new payload fields; verify a live Edge TRAIN click.

checkpoints.description: [2/3] Five-rank fleet veterancy table, rank-scaled damage/evasion, scaled victory XP with promotion logs, docked train_fleet_ship, /api/fleet/escort/train, fleet train CLI and rank/XP/TRAIN fleet cards implemented with regressions.
[3/3] README, COCKPIT and ADR-095 recorded; live Edge trained a corvette from 0 to 10 XP for 200 cr; 840 tests and 5/5 gates pass. checklists: passed
Task 'fleet-veterancy' completed successfully.
[1/3] Plan remote patrol sweeps: every 6 ticks each remote escort hunts pirates for scaled bounty credits, XP and return-fire damage, surfaced in the fleet report, card and CLI.

impact_assessment.why: Remote escorts reduced piracy but earned no XP or income, so deployment away from the flagship was a pure sacrifice and the new rank system only rewarded local battles.
impact_assessment.benefits: Stationing a hull on patrol becomes a slower but real progression and income path, and fleet deployment gains a risk/reward choice.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: patrol results must stay deterministic and existing saves must not need new fields; dependency: fleet.py now reads pirate risk and the tick consumes patrol credits; concurrency: the tick mutates fleet hulls, XP, credits, stats and the flight log together; state: unattended patrols can be damaged or destroyed, and the 6-tick cadence must not double-run.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Add pure sweep, contact, XP and tick-integration regressions first; cap XP at Ace; use seed + ship id + tick for determinism; verify the cockpit label and a live sweep.

checkpoints.description: [2/3] Deterministic 6-tick patrol sweeps with pirate-risk contact chance, scaled bounties, 1/3 XP, return-fire damage, patrol credits in tick payload/stats, fleet-report cadence, cockpit label and CLI footer implemented with regressions.
[3/3] README, COCKPIT and ADR-096 recorded; live Edge showed PATROL 6T and a sweep paying 77 cr/+3 XP/-2 hull; 844 tests and 5/5 gates pass. checklists: passed
Task 'patrol-sweeps' completed successfully.
[1/3] Plan faction trade pacts: a standing-40 agreement that improves buy and sell prices, persists per faction, is refused at war, and is surfaced in the Empire tab and CLI.

impact_assessment.why: Standing 40 had no distinct reward between gifts and the standing-70 alliance, and war had no economic cost beyond severed trade links.
impact_assessment.benefits: Diplomacy gains a mid-tier commercial goal, trade routes gain a durable benefit, and war now suspends a valuable agreement.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: trade_pacts must default empty for legacy saves and every player-facing quote must use the same pact flag; dependency: the quote signature changes and six callers must pass the flag; concurrency: diplomacy mutates standings, pacts and the flight log in one locked transaction; state: pacts persist and must be suspended, not deleted, during war.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Add quote, standing-gate, war-suspension, persistence and UI/CLI regressions first; default the quote parameter false; verify the live Empire PACT click and market prices.

checkpoints.description: [2/3] Persisted trade_pacts, standing-40/war gates, 6% quote improvement across local trade, automation, quantum freight, depot sales and snapshots, Empire PACT control, CLI action/status and market header implemented with regressions.
[3/3] README, COCKPIT and ADR-097 recorded; live Edge formed a Sol Coalition pact and moved titanium 208/164 to 195/173 buy/sell; 852 tests and 5/5 gates pass. checklists: passed
Task 'trade-pacts' completed successfully.
